Bull-man protecting a palmtree, detail from a panel of molded bricks (1940s reconstruction). Terracotta, middle 12th century BC. Found at the Tell of the Apadana in Susa.
The inscription running along the central band record that Shilhak-Inshushinak made a statue of brick for the exterior chapel of Inshushinak.
